why: A commit, not a release, and that is a gap rather than a shortcut.

brand ADR 0003 makes the Assets release the distribution unit, and tokens/ IS one of the bundle CATEGORIES. But assets/wallpaper/ is deliberately excluded from that bundle, and the wallpaper set landed in bbcff9b on 2026-08-06, three days after the 2026.08 tag. There is no release containing everything red-dev needs.

tokens.json also moved after the tag: every hex is byte-identical, but the $extensions.reddb.contrastGuardrail blocks are new, and those are the reason for vendoring the source rather than a distillation of it.
Filed upstream: cut a release containing the wallpaper set, and add assets/wallpaper/ to CATEGORIES in scripts/bundle.mjs.
wallpaperNote: A different commit to the tokens above, and on an unmerged branch: reddb-io/brand#98 makes the wallpapers 8-bit. The bytes are final; what is pending is a look at 01, 14 and 25 on a real 4K panel, because RMSE cannot see banding and fourteen of those sheets are halo gradients. Move this pin to the merge commit when #98 lands. If the review rejects the 8-bit change, these six change with it — which is the dependency this line exists to record.
